title: Declarative residency manifest and continuous evidence collector for hosted API
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Problem: Customers need a simple, testable way to declare where tenant data may be processed and stored for Hosted API workloads and to automatically produce attested evidence that their residency/retention commitments are being met. Current offerings (manual region pins + ad-hoc exports) are error-prone and require SRE/Support intervention for audits.

Goal: Ship a declarative Residency Manifest API and Console editor that lets tenants express location constraints (hard pin, soft affinity, allowed regions, retention windows) and attach SLA/contract meta. Complement the manifest with a Continuous Evidence Collector that automatically compiles, signs, and exports an evidence package on-demand or on a schedule. The evidence package should include routing decision logs, retention enforcement traces, storage region assertions, and a tamper-evident bundle suitable for compliance audits.

Scope: Hosted API only (initial release). Not covering Dedicated or Private deployments in phase 1. Deliverables: 1) Residency Manifest schema + API (create/read/update) 2) Console editor and YAML import/export 3) Enforcement modes: hard (reject non-compliant requests) and soft (route preference + telemetry) 4) Continuous Evidence Collector service with export formats (zip + signed manifest, JSON trace, CSV summary) 5) Operator tooling for on-demand evidence snapshots and audit exports 6) Documentation and evaluation prompts for customers to validate behavior.

Non-goals: Global data archival workflows, on-prem manifest enforcement, and billing changes.

Success criteria: - Customers can author a manifest and validate routing decisions via an interactive console in <15 minutes - Evidence exports include signed routing traces + retention actions and can be generated on-demand within 30s - No more than 5% request routing latency regression in soft mode, and <1% error rate increase in hard mode at rollout - First 3 pilot customers successfully use the export for compliance audits without manual SRE intervention.

2026-03-03 — Diego Alvarez: Reviewed prototype schema from ENG. Trade-off: signable evidence bundles require KMS work; security prefers using existing KMS integration rather than bespoke signing. Added ENG-84712 as dependency for KMS signing certificates.
2026-03-05 — Leah Kim (Security): Security review notes attached. Must include key rotation metadata and signer identity in evidence bundle. Marked security_review_required.

2026-03-07 — Engineering (ENG-84210): Submitted design doc and sample routing trace format. Proposed compressed CSV + JSON manifest for trace and an index file for quick validation. Link to PRD draft in Confluence in links below.

2026-03-09 — UX review (Design): Initial console mockups OK but requested clearer feedback when a manifest would cause request rejections (hard mode). Design to add a 'dry-run' validation step in the editor. Added DES-2102 follow-up for microcopy and empty-state flows.

2026-03-11 — Diego Alvarez: Pilot outreach plan: target three enterprise customers who previously requested residency controls. Need legal signoff on contract_id field semantics. Assigned to Legal (blocking until 2026-03-18).

2026-03-12 — Maya Patel: Scope freeze for manifest schema. Moving forward with API naming convention residency.manifests.v1. Next: finalize evidence collector retention of raw traces for 90 days and implement export TTL controls.
